scanPrecision: authored / candidates = 2 / 18 (11 %): the cheap scan is a recall filter; the author is the precision step. Next improvement: drop identity / normative 'proves you are', 'you have to' sentences and ASR fragments in the scan.
lessons: a person + a ring cannot show 'stop doing X' — the cause stays invisible (radical-compassion 128); an action cause needs an action glyph or a quote of the cause
negated or 'without' clauses must never become the drawn effect (now enforced)
